plan.scope: Fresh production campaign factory/evaluator feasibility. Authored public8303 is separate from declared QA constructor-seed stress openings. No generic relabeling, post-setup state mutation, script tuning or human balance claim.
plan.heldOutStatus: Unopened; require final dependency-aware freeze and coordinator gate before execution.
plan.numericChanges: Only new optional medals180seconds/4500HP. Core-only completion600s; ordinary policy/formation/treasuries unchanged.
plan.freezeBoundary: All actual runtime files, production factory/evaluator, unchanged player/economy modules, simulator,auditor,plan and module config. Full canonical source-tree integrity is separate.

preregisteredHeldOutAdmission.scope: Accepted before any protected game is constructed or evaluated. This declarative rule does not change runtime, player scripts, formation, prices, economy, scheduling or authoritative evaluation.

all18Cases.identity: Reproduce the exact production mission/rules/map revisions and declared constructor seed. Protected seeds are QA stress openings, not randomized public starts.
all18Cases.attempts: Retain every AI public-action attempt, including failed attempts, and reproduce the fixed player script deterministically.
all18Cases.receipts: Retain every successful paid player/AI receipt, normal prices, income, kill gold, refunds and final treasury. The frozen independent auditor must pass.
all18Cases.playerFailedCallBoundary: Failed player calls are not individually retained. They remain reproducible by exact fixed-script execution; do not claim a stored player-failure trace.
all18Cases.stateAndEvaluation: Reproduce the complete final state and authoritative core outcome, reason and optional medals. Preserve own-loss/draw precedence and the normal 300-second escalation.
all18Cases.restoreBoundary: Every simulator case performs an exact final Game.restore/serialize round trip. Per-case battle-codec/profile/native restore is not claimed; focused and native persistence checks are separate.
all18Cases.incompleteRun: Any missing, errored, censored or irreproducible case pauses admission. Preserve every loss/error and completed record; do not skip or selectively replace cases.

gameplayReadiness.requiredWitnesses: There must exist a first-commit-road-majority winning case and an other-roads-majority winning case from different supported policy IDs across the full 18-case matrix.
gameplayReadiness.winDefinition: The authoritative campaign evaluator reports completion and the recorded core-only outcome is won; optional medal counts do not determine readiness.
gameplayReadiness.firstCommittedRoad: Use the lane of the earliest actual paid enemy commit transition in ordered side 1 AI decisions, corroborated by its successful ordinary receipt. Use that first lane even if later commitments turn or collapse; do not choose a later favorable lane.
gameplayReadiness.damageDefinition: Traverse damage entries in their recorded chronological order. Use positive applied damage with targetType === 'base', targetSide === 1 and source.side === 0. Every counted source.lane must be valid; do not invent or silently discard missing attribution.
gameplayReadiness.firstCoreDamageBoundary: Use the first such applied enemy-core damage event tick; cross-check its time against firstCoreDamage[1].
gameplayReadiness.firstCommitRoadMajority: Qualifying roads are the singleton first committed lane. Require 2 * F > T.
gameplayReadiness.otherRoadsMajority: Qualifying roads are all valid lane IDs other than the first committed lane. Require 2 * O > T.
gameplayReadiness.majorityComparison: Strict greater-than with recorded applied amounts, not attempted shots, rounded percentages or a tuned epsilon. A 50/50 tie qualifies as neither class.
gameplayReadiness.qualifyingProductionReceipts: Count successful side 0 build/upgrade receipt entries with cost > 0 whose frozen exact building definition has a troop-producing unit. Exclude mines and towers. The receipt lane must belong to the relevant road class.
gameplayReadiness.qualifyingPurchaseDeadline: receipt.tick must be strictly less than the first enemy-core-damage tick. Same-tick purchases do not qualify.
gameplayReadiness.receiptCountingUnit: Count receipt entries, without a distinct-building requirement. Failed or zero-cost actions do not count.
gameplayReadiness.damagePartition: Accumulate F chronologically from entries on the first committed road and O chronologically from entries on all other valid roads. Then define T = F + O; do not compute a differently ordered independent total.

paidEnemySiegePressure.caseScope: A witness may be anywhere in the complete 18-case matrix, including the two scripts excluded from winning qualification.
paidEnemySiegePressure.paidProduction: Require an earlier successful positive-cost side 1 foundry build/upgrade receipt and an ordinary side 1 siege spawn whose producerId and lane match that paid foundry.
paidEnemySiegePressure.appliedPressure: After that ordinary spawn, require positive applied damage with source.side === 1, source.type siege, targetSide === 0 and the same recorded lane. A firing attempt alone is insufficient.
paidEnemySiegePressure.ordering: The paid foundry receipt tick precedes the spawn tick; the spawn tick is no later than the applied-damage tick.
paidEnemySiegePressure.lineageBoundary: Spawn records do not store unitId. Do not claim a directly logged spawn-to-specific-attacker link. Zero initial enemy siege/foundries, ordinary production-only source and exact deterministic replay establish the paid mechanism.

preregisteredHeldOutAdmission.failurePolicy: If complete evidence or either readiness class or actual paid siege pressure is missing, pause admission and report. Do not retune against, selectively rerun, replace or silently exclude these protected seeds.

knownEvidenceProvenance.noRetroactivePlanClaim: The original known36 and clock-only known36 archives used their own original PLAN bytes. Do not relabel them as runs under this later declaration.

closure.scope: Actual runtime and complete declared simulator/evaluator/player-policy/auditor/config dependency closure; full repository integrity is separate.

mission.name: The Hammer Turns
mission.subtitle: Read the siege commitment and choose your answer
mission.description: The coastal commander has infantry and archers on every road, but no siege foundry yet. New paid construction shows where the hammer will fall, while the other roads remain defended.

dialogue.speaker: Engineer Bram
dialogue.text: Watch where they build the foundry. We can meet its army with support, or spend our coin on another road.

mission.victoryText: The enemy citadel falls and the siege crews abandon their works. The company has another foothold, but more of the Siege Coast remains ahead.
mission.objective: Destroy the enemy citadel within 10:00. Your citadel must survive.
mission.hint: Watch newly built enemy foundries. Confront the supported siege road or build a supported attack elsewhere, while covering the other approaches. No road, unit or foundry target is required.
briefing: Classic: 3,200-unit battlefield, 3 lanes, 24 building sites per side
1,100 starting gold; your citadel starts at 6,000 HP; enemy citadel starts at 6,000 HP
Your deployment: North: 1 × level-1 Barracks; Middle: 1 × level-1 Barracks, 1 × level-1 Archery range, 1 × level-1 Gold mine; South: 1 × level-1 Barracks
Enemy deployment: North: 1 × level-1 Barracks, 1 × level-1 Archery range; Middle: 1 × level-1 Barracks, 1 × level-1 Archery range; South: 1 × level-1 Barracks, 1 × level-1 Archery range
Normal adaptive enemy starts with 320 gold and ordinary income; it pays for buildings, upgrades and arrow volleys

All three roads are fully visible. The enemy starts with infantry and archery production on each road, no siege foundry and no mine. Its ordinary 5 gold/sec and 320-gold treasury pay for later works. Your real mine gives 7.5 gold/sec including ordinary income.
Destroy the enemy citadel by 10:00 while yours survives; 1 HP is enough. No road, building target or unit is mandatory. The 3:00 and 4,500 HP bonus stars are optional.

The enemy may commit paid siege investment to a supported road while maintaining basic defense elsewhere. A funded commitment normally stays for 45 seconds. Losing its last foundry, forward screen producer or forward archery range ends the commitment and starts a 20-second reselection cooldown; rebuilding support can take longer. A later turn needs a supported alternative, a real advantage and a useful ordinary paid purchase. Turns are possible, not guaranteed periodic waves.

New buildings appear immediately. Their first ordinary troops follow about 1.2 seconds later, then travel normally. There is no special construction countdown or hidden-intent marker. Emergency defense shares the same treasury and at most two construction/upgrade attempts per normal decision; it can delay siege investment. No free units, income subsidy, reserve wave or forced drain is added.

All eight earned buildings, automatic adjacent-road flyers and normal paid citadel choices are available. At 5:00 ordinary escalation speeds production ×1.65, multiplies troop structure damage ×1.75 and lowers citadel shot damage from 32 to 18.
